name: Onboarding Tour screen renders from the sidebar
description: From the seeded repo, navigate to the Onboarding Tour via the sidebar and confirm the screen renders its generate gate. Exercises the repo-scoped route /repos/<id>/onboarding, the nav entry, and the GET /repos/:id/onboarding view endpoint. STRICTLY read-only: it never clicks Generate — that would spend a real LLM call on every e2e run and write a row. The generation path is covered by the hermetic server tests (onboarding-service, onboarding-gate). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api is the first repo, same as flows 02/04/05.

steps.label: land on the seeded repo's PR list
open the Onboarding Tour from the sidebar
the generate gate renders for a repo with no tour yet
